title.narrative: Facilidad para el Financiamiento de Cadenas Productivas de Sacyr Construcción (México, Chile, Colombia, Paraguay y Perú)

description.narrative: The Project consists of a revolving, uncommitted supply chain payment services financing of up to US$20 million or their equivalent in Mexican pesos (the “Financing”) to provide supply chain payment services to Sacyr Construcción México S.A. De C.V. and Sacyr Alvarga Hospital Acuña S.A.P.I. de C.V. Suppliers (the “Borrowers”). The Financing will have an initial term of 12 months, which may be renewed annually at IDB Invest's discretion for up to 6 additional years. The Financing will provide Sacyr suppliers an innovative alternative solution to finance its working capital needs by using the E-Factor Network platform.This solution will allow the Borrowers’ supplier base (which includes small and medium enterprises [SMEs]) to secure financing under much more favorable conditions than would be available directly from the local market. SME supply chain financing through companies like Sacyr is one of the ways that IDB Invest will serve this segment. The above is in line with the innovative focus proposed by IDB Invest for SMEs.
